title: How a Long-Shot U.S. Oil Drilling Project Is Shaking Up Greenland
summary_full: A U.S. oil company says it could be on the verge of a major discovery in Greenland. The proposal comes at a tricky time for the Arctic island, and locals are lining up against it.
